activities.activity_description: Analyze requirements for all user stories, review spring-bus architecture (U5), and define the technical approach for integrating Ambari, Spring Cloud Config, and Hadoop LocalFileSystem.

activities.activity_name: Ambari Plugin for Spring XD on YARN (U1, U6)
activities.activity_description: Develop the Ambari plugin to support Spring XD installed on YARN, update the plugin to support upgrading from 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA, and write the necessary upgrade documentation.
Integrate spring-cloud-config server with spring-bus modules to enable centralized management of external properties.
Investigate channel performance issues in Spring Integration 4.2, profile the bottlenecks, and document corrective actions.
Implement tooling and benchmarks to measure the baseline serialization characteristics in Spring XD to identify performance improvement areas.
Modify the jdbchdfs job to properly handle fsUri = file:// to use Hadoop LocalFileSystem for single-node setups.
Add the option to specify system properties that will be passed to the Sqoop job running in its own Java process.
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all implemented features across the YARN, Ambari, and Hadoop environments.
Compile and finalize all user-facing documentation, including the Ambari upgrade guide and release notes for the software increment.
